scope.source_identity: LEGACY-CAND-LINE-000001 through LEGACY-CAND-LINE-004755, exact IDs from routing snapshot and carry-forward ledger
scope.excluded: Any inference of adoption, exact coverage, formal successor, requirement retirement, stage closure, acceptance execution or implementation/execution permission.

pinned_inputs.role: source-item classification/router and source identity snapshot; all 4,755 JSONL records scanned
all 4,755 source IDs, source path/line/hash, authority and carry-forward state
92 archive documents / 4,755 non-empty source-line population definition
#2341 full-population classification and route baseline; no arithmetic carry-forward

historical_baseline.handling: This audit re-enumerates the full source population from the pinned router and carry-forward ledger; it does not add correction deltas to the prior totals or modify the historical artifact.

reconciliation_rules.classification: Initialize each row from the pinned router classification; source requirement_atom rows map to the condition bucket with product_requirement_atom subtype. Apply exact-ID classification corrections only from the pinned historical audits.
reconciliation_rules.condition_bucket: All source condition rows count in the condition total, including management_process_condition and concept_condition; only product_requirement_atom is the product requirement atom subtype.
reconciliation_rules.base_route: For condition rows, map documented_relation/mapped_source_basis_coverage_unresolved to source_relation_coverage_unresolved; candidate_routed_unadopted/candidate_only_unadopted to unadopted_candidate_relation_only; unknown/unknown_after_semantic_check to unknown.
reconciliation_rules.route_overlays: Apply exact-ID route outcome from #2341 crosswalk outcomes, then #2342 adopted_relevant_partial on its 20 rows, then #2345 proposed route states. #2345 management_successor_unresolved is a separate management route state without a product L2/L11 route.
reconciliation_rules.route_known_definition: A known route is an explicit route status other than unknown or management_successor_unresolved. Known/partial states do not mean exact coverage or source closure.

prior_#2341_corrections_retained.interpretation: 19 already incorporated in the #2341 full recount: 12 prior description/R2253/R2254 corrections plus 7 new RTG conditions.

row_state_join: Join each source_item_id to the pinned carry-forward ledger for exact archive path/line/file SHA/line SHA; all 4,755 joined rows were verified against physical archive bytes.
limitations: This recount is limited to the 4,755-line candidate-source population defined by the pinned inventory; it is not a claim about other legacy requirements or candidate populations.
Management-process conditions and the historical Concept condition are included in the condition count, but only product_requirement_atom is a product requirement atom subtype.

Route-known includes source relation with coverage unresolved, unadopted candidate relation only, and bounded partial/unresolved/covered_limited/adopted_relevant_partial outcomes. None means exact adopted coverage or full no-loss semantic closure.
The four management_successor_unresolved rows have no assigned product L2/L11 route. Their unresolved status is not a product route or successor assignment.
All 4,755 source authority states remain historical_candidate; target states remain draft_candidate; atomization remains preserved_pending_atomization.
No requirement adoption/rejection/retirement, formal successor, L3 transition, stage 5/6 completion, implementation/execution permission, or acceptance execution is asserted.
No old runtime, test, CLI, hook, or CI was executed.
